tei:div.tei:p: “A Prayer for Relatives to Recite Prior to the Donation of Organs of their Beloved (for a male)” by Dr. Yael Levine is the third of four prayers offered by the author in 2024 in the event of an organ transplant procedure. Dr. Levine writes, “תפילות אלו התחברו על ידי לפי פנייתו של הרב ד”ר שלמה ברודי אליי עבור ארגון “אימתי” שהוא עומד בראשו, ועלו שם לאתר במחצית שנת 2024. (These prayers were composed by myself at the request of Rabbi Dr. Shlomo Brody for the “Ematai” organization that he heads, and were uploaded to the website in mid-2024.)
